whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Lazeez Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has been serving Patna on Fraser Road with 260+ reviews, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and menu page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, digital menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/lazeez

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Lazeez Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Lazeez Restaurant on Fraser Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a digital menu, direct WhatsApp table reservation, and mobile-first speed for your diners in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
